subject: Puppy

Paired ears, separate paws/body sections and repeated orange/green ball panels provide repeated color matching; the slipper adds several large blue regions.

Bold silhouette and large accessories produce materially more engaging painting than the original tan puppy with one turquoise accessory. Some tan shadows remain, but meaningful palette variety does not depend on them.
